description: Überschwemmungsgebiete (natürlich, Abgrenzungen 1900 - 1913) Landkreis Diepholz is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Natural floodplains in the district of Diepholz, retreats from 1900 - 1913. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Floodplains (natural, demarcations 1900 - 1913) District Diepholz" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Überschwemmungsgebiete, inspireidentifiziert, Gebiete mit naturbedingten Risiken, ÜSG. The listing shows 2009-11-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
